title: wkbuild
desc: wkbuild.cmd at repo ROOT is the ONLY official build entry (thin shim to bin/wktest-build.sh) -- storm-safe single-file publish plus smoke plus auto-deploy to bin/wkappbot-core.exe. Hot-swap a running Eye with wktest-promote. Run in FOREGROUND because a detached wkbuild orphans and dies instantly. Mapping skill so the wk-tool first-use nudge resolves wkbuild to its usage.
steps: ENTRY: wkbuild.cmd at the repo ROOT is the ONLY official build entry -- a thin shim to bin/wktest-build.sh. Run ./wkbuild.cmd from the repo root in FOREGROUND (no flags needed).

BUILD: dotnet single-file self-contained publish, version computed from git rev-list, staged as wktest-core-MODEL-vVER.exe, then auto smoke and auto-deploy by cp over bin/wkappbot-core.exe on smoke PASS. NO .new.exe marker is written (that .new.exe FSW marker caused the wkappbot-core spawn storm).
PROMOTE: wktest-promote is the sanctioned running-Eye hot-swap (it writes the .new.exe marker the live Eye watches) and refuses unless smoke passed (FORCE=1 bypasses with a loud warning).

FOREGROUND ONLY: a detached/background wkbuild orphans and dies instantly because the .cmd-to-bash child detaches on background; run it in the foreground. DIAGNOSIS: zero dotnet/bash process + empty output + no _pub_ dir = the build NEVER STARTED (orphaned shell), not a slow test.

See also: wktest-staging-build-storm-safe-deploy-pipeline (full pipeline + smoke/gc/promote detail), wkappbot-build-verify-workflow (how to verify a green build), wkdoctor-system-physician (DefenderFix when the canonical exe is quarantined).
